status: exploratory; designed after source inspection; not preregistered
scope: Mohenjo-daro rows catalogued TAB:C; not assumed identical to Parpola incised/painted copper category
literal_parser: Reuse parse_lipi; additionally permit NR only for a literal one-token text. No variant merging, direction reversal, or inferred missing signs.
donor: Exactly one retained singleton row and one retained longer-text row on an artifact, distinct IDs, and no retained motif-bearing row. This counts qualified source rows, not an authenticated physical-face inventory.
match: Donor longer text exactly equals motif-bearing text on a different artifact; keep literal source labels including Othr without translating them.
deduplication: Count distinct donor artifacts and distinct recipient artifacts; retain recipient row IDs. Duplicate source rows do not become independent artifacts.
sensitivity: Repeat requiring Good or Fair condition on every retained contributing row. Quality is source metadata, not independent visual verification.
inference_limit: Bridges associate motifs with entire shared texts and singleton reverses. They cannot identify a particular sign in the longer text as the animal name. Source-derived and reconstructed evidence is not independent replication.
